limits.value: 10,000 Neurons per day, reset at 00:00 UTC; further operations fail with an error past it

300 requests per minute for Text Generation, a default per task type, unless the model requires the Workers Paid plan; models that require it fall under the per-account, per-model limit in the next row. unverified: whether the 300 is counted per account is not stated for the default limits
20 requests a minute per account per model on standard billing for the eight paid-only models, 50 requests a minute with prepaid AI Gateway credits

other task types, requests per minute: Automatic Speech Recognition 720; Image-to-Text 720; Text-to-Image 720 (@cf/runwayml/stable-diffusion-v1-5-img2img 1500); Translation 720; Image Classification 3000; Object Detection 3000; Summarization 1500; Text Classification 2000; Text Embeddings 3000 (@cf/baai/bge-large-en-v1.5 1500)

free_tier.stated: 10,000 Neurons per day at no charge on both the Free and the Paid Workers plan. The page states the daily figure; the monthly figure of 300,000 and the token equivalents below are derived arithmetic on it, not vendor statements
free_tier.notes: billing is in Neurons. The page prints a per-token price beside each model as an equivalent, so a single USD per million tokens figure for Workers AI does not exist. The free-plan input rate runs from 1,542 to 60,000 neurons per million tokens across 31 models, a factor of 38.9, so the token count behind one allowance is model-dependent: 194.6 million a month at the cheapest and 5.0 million at the dearest Derived figures and their bases: 300,000 = 10,000 x 30 days; 122.1 million input tokens = 300,000 / 2,457 x 1,000,000; 4.07 million a day = that divided by 30

identity_cost.detail: a Cloudflare account; the Workers Free plan is enough for the daily allocation

reliability_note: eight named models require a paid billing method and fail on a Free plan
confidence_note: the allocation, the reset and the paid-only model list are quoted from the vendor pages read. No call was made, because that needs an account.

evidence.proved: 10,000 Neurons per day free, USD 0.011 per 1,000 Neurons above it on Workers Paid, all limits reset daily at 00:00 UTC, and eight named models require a paid billing method including @cf/moonshotai/kimi-k2.6 and @cf/zai-org/glm-5.3-flash

per-model neuron rates over 39 text-generation models, of which 31 are reachable on the free plan; input runs from 1,542 neurons per million tokens on @cf/ibm-granite/granite-4.0-h-micro to 60,000 on @cf/qwen/qwq-32b, and the eight paid-only ids run to 127,273 on @cf/zai-org/glm-5.3

Text Generation is 300 requests per minute, 'unless the model requires the Workers Paid plan'; Image Classification, Object Detection and Text Embeddings are 3000; Summarization 1500; Text Classification 2000; and the eight paid models are 20 requests per minute on standard billing or 50 with prepaid AI Gateway credits

notes: 300,000 Neurons a month, not 375 million: 10,000 a day times 30. At 2,457 neurons per million input tokens that is 122.1 million input tokens a month and 4.07 million a day. The output half alone is 2.3 times it. Every figure beyond the page's own 10,000 a day is arithmetic on it and is labelled as such in free_tier.stated.
